source_review.notes: Reviewed current Linux circular-buffer and memory-barrier documentation, Zephyr ring-buffer APIs, DPDK ring library modes, Boost circular_buffer, Rust VecDeque, the ISO C++ atomic-order draft, LMAX Disruptor guide and technical account, and FreeBSD buf_ring(9). All ten final destinations returned HTTP 200. Legacy Rust SPSC material was inspected only as candidate context; its useful proof obligations were independently scoped and no implementation was copied.

evidence: Checked C/K/h/t/n/R notation, physical mapping, successor, occupancy, span, sequence, role, publication, and linearization terminology.
Separated counted, sentinel, flag/phase, and monotonic-counter state rather than combining incompatible full/empty equations.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Every modulo-C expression is scoped to positive physical capacity; usable and physical capacity are explicitly distinguished.

evidence: Replayed capacity-four A/B/C/D, rejected E, overwritten A with E, consumed B/C, and appended F/G.
Confirmed final D,E,F,G; head 3; size/capacity 4; one rejection; one drop; wrapped true; invariant true.
Recomputed the capacity-five exercise through full, two removals, wrap, rejection, and overwrite, including physical slots and logical order.
Checked sentinel example C=4,r=1,w=0 gives occupancy 3 and full next(w)=r.
numerical_recomputation.notes: These are finite recomputations and do not establish concurrent, fixed-width, or arbitrary-record correctness.

evidence: Re-derived injectivity of p(i)=(h+i) mod C for 0<=i<n<=C from logical-index difference strictly below C.
Verified counted enqueue/dequeue transitions preserve FIFO mapping, one-element cardinality change, and live-slot ownership.
Verified sentinel empty/full/occupancy formulas and the loss of exactly one usable physical slot.
Checked first readable span min(n,C-h) and second n-first cover exactly n values in logical order.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Counter rollover statements are conditional on defined unsigned arithmetic, bounded true distance, and comparison assumptions; no universal rollover claim is made.

evidence: Reviewed physical/usable capacity zero and one, empty, singleton, exact full, every wrap adjacency, power-of-two masking preconditions, pre-modulo overflow, and counter rollover.
Reviewed reject, overwrite, block, all-or-nothing bulk, partial bulk, lost-data metrics, sustained overload, and clean shutdown.
Reviewed one/two-span grants, smaller-than-requested contiguous regions, over-commit, abandoned reservation, out-of-order producer completion, framing corruption, padding, alignment, and restart.
Reviewed SPSC role duplication, publication/reclamation reorder, MPMC gaps, approximate cursor snapshots, false sharing, DMA coherency, and device teardown.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: The chapter explicitly separates CPU-thread synchronization from device-visible memory and does not transfer an SPSC proof to MPMC.

evidence: Checked 0<=size<=capacity, normalized head for nonempty storage, exact live physical set, and one non-None value per live educational slot after each trace transition.
Checked reject leaves storage/head/size/drop count unchanged and overwrite advances head, preserves full size, replaces exactly the oldest value, and increments loss once.
Checked the SPSC slot cycle from free through reserved/initialized/published/consumed/reclaimed and the role that owns each transition.
invariant_checking.notes: The executable invariant reserves None as a marker and is not a generic object-lifetime implementation.

evidence: Reviewed the counted mapping and transition preservation argument line by line.
Reviewed the two distinct SPSC release/acquire transfers: initialized payload to consumer and reclaimed storage to producer.
Reviewed why unique participant roles precede ordering choice and why a second producer requires unique reservation and gap-aware publication.
Reviewed variable-record bounds/recovery obligations and why an in-memory protocol does not imply crash consistency.
proof_review.notes: The concurrency discussion is an obligation register, not a certified implementation or formal proof of a named MPMC algorithm.

evidence: Capacity/mapping arguments state positivity, range, and encoding assumptions.
SPSC claims state exactly one producer/consumer and bind acquire/release meaning to the implementation memory model.
MPMC, DMA, persistence, progress, hard latency, and performance remain explicit additional-evidence boundaries.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No atomic primitive, platform barrier, or stress run is presented as a universal proof.

evidence: The standard-library Python snippet passed exact nine-line stdout, empty stderr, and zero exit status under recorded Python 3.14.4.
The snippet emits evidence=finite_ring_policy_trace and the text immediately limits it to sequential policy/mapping cases.
All ten reference destinations returned HTTP 200 and repository validation checked local links.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No concurrent ring, variable-record parser, persistent mapping, DMA device, kernel/API implementation, cache layout, rollover-duration run, or production benchmark was empirically evaluated.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed FIFO abstraction, counted/sentinel/flag/phase/counter encodings, overload semantics, spans and leases, record framing, SPSC ownership transfer, MPMC separation, hardware ownership, approximate observation, validation, and alternatives.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed capacity units, checked arithmetic, live-value cleanup, loss evidence, retries/backpressure, partial bulk contracts, abandoned leases, corrupt framing, shutdown, participant topology, memory-model selection, device coherency, metrics, realistic schedule tests, and workload-equivalent benchmarks.

pedagogical_review.notes: Builds from sequential FIFO and mapping before policy, zero-copy records, and concurrency; preserves only independently checked legacy proof insights; supplies a reproduced boundary trace, thirteen misconceptions, ten varied worked examples, and five progressive exercises with complete model answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, executable-snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external standard-library, compiler, kernel, device, database, networking, concurrency, security, reliability, safety, real-time, hardware, operations, architecture, or independent academic review is claimed. The chapter and finite trace prove neither generic lifetime/failure safety, arbitrary capacity/counter correctness, data-race freedom, linearizability, lock-free progress, fairness, reclamation, crash consistency, DMA coherency, zero loss, hard latency, benchmark superiority, certification, nor deployment fitness.
